# Let me try the AND version of the bridge rule:
# Mark 2 if cell has pattern on BOTH horizontal AND BOTH vertical (4-directional)

def apply_and_bridge(grid, bg_val=1, pattern_val=7, fill_val=2):
    """Mark 2 if cell has pattern on both horizontal AND on both vertical"""
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == bg_val:
                # Check if pattern exists both left and right in this row
                row = grid[r]
                has_pattern_left = any(row[k] == pattern_val for k in range(c))
                has_pattern_right = any(row[k] == pattern_val for k in range(c+1, cols))
                horiz_condition = has_pattern_left and has_pattern_right
                
                # Check if pattern exists both up and down in this col
                col = [grid[k][c] for k in range(rows)]
                has_pattern_up = any(col[k] == pattern_val for k in range(r))
                has_pattern_down = any(col[k] == pattern_val for k in range(r+1, rows))
                vert_condition = has_pattern_up and has_pattern_down
                
                # AND rule: must satisfy BOTH
                if horiz_condition and vert_condition:
                    result[r][c] = fill_val
    return result
